name: Shoulder Press (Plate Loaded)
instructions: Sit at the plate-loaded shoulder press machine, back flat against the pad.
Grip the handles at shoulder height with a neutral or overhand grip.
Press the handles overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower with control. The plate-loaded path provides a natural pressing arc.
longevityNotes: Pressing keeps shoulders useful, but joint-friendly volume beats grinding maxes. Full range, controlled tempo, and balanced pulling keep the shoulders healthy for decades.
overview: A beginner machine press-pattern exercise targeting the front delts. Shoulder Press (Plate Loaded) builds the upper-body pushing strength used in everything from getting off the floor to overhead reaching.
